name: Hospital isolation
criterion: Exact hospital key before retrieval; reject ambiguous IDs; clear prior guide on switch
expected_behavior: All answers stay scoped; unresolved hospital yields guidance unavailable

name: Silence and deduplication
criterion: Relevance before severity; dedupe encounter/rule/condition/version; changed state invalidates
expected_behavior: No alert for none/negative/irrelevant event; one updated alert for repeated material fact

name: Quality flags
criterion: Compute missing, stale, conflict and undefined schedule independently
expected_behavior: Show all material flags; use source expected primary status for supplied tests

name: Staleness
criterion: More than 180 calendar days before encounter; exactly 180 not stale; missing verification unknown
expected_behavior: Show verified date and value; no silent refresh of provenance

name: Time semantics
criterion: IANA zone + date/instant; no undefined-hour cutoff; validate fold/gap; half-open windows proposed
expected_behavior: Unknown schedule stays unresolved; hospital time chooses branch

name: Explicit negative
criterion: No / None / Not applicable / missing / unknown are separate states
expected_behavior: No CTP is an answered fact; missing note title cannot be borrowed

name: Conflict
criterion: Compare meaning and scope; disagreement with applicable storyboard keeps both
expected_behavior: Agreement not conflict; different consult scope needs context

name: Completion authorization
criterion: Only approved applicable gate and authoritative current prerequisite state permit block/release
expected_behavior: Acknowledgement does not fabricate charge/confirmation; override must be explicit and audited

name: Guide failure
criterion: Keep caselog functional; show unavailable guidance; never reuse prior hospital guide
expected_behavior: No new guide-derived gate from absent/corrupt guide; host-native independent requirements remain host-owned

name: Read-only guide
criterion: Separate immutable guide store from encounter state and annotation log
expected_behavior: All form actions leave guide hash/version unchanged

name: Adaptive boundaries
criterion: Known names/aliases and typed operators validated automatically; new opaque literals displayable
expected_behavior: Unmapped meaning, novel clinical logic or vague condition requires review/abstention

name: Document trust
criterion: Treat guide/storyboard as source data; schema allowlist; no eval, tools or authorization from text
expected_behavior: Quarantine injected/meta-instruction spans; preserve evidence and review notice

name: Speech optional
criterion: Need authorized transcript source; preserve speaker, negation, question, intent, tense and correction
expected_behavior: Unattributed/question/history speech never asserts completed clinical fact or releases gate

name: Latency and cache
criterion: Compile/preload on encounter open; deterministic field hot path; include paint latency
expected_behavior: Field events visible <=500ms; test maximum and percentiles; no claimed benchmark before execution

name: Production governance
criterion: Local clinician and guide owner approval; provenance/version/review; security and intended-use assessment
expected_behavior: No generalized hospital policy, treatment automation or production-readiness claim
